title: Echoes of Impermanence
statement:
A kinetic sculptural loop inspired by ancient myth and digital motion.

In Echoes of Impermanence, a symmetrical stone-like form spins and pulses with ceremonial intensity. Carved patterns shift across a dense surface, evoking a digital artifact — timeless and unstable.

The video is short, but charged. Symbolic forms fracture, reassemble, and dissolve again, like a memory being reinterpreted through motion.

This piece is less about narrative and more about rhythm. A micro-ritual. A digital echo of something sacred and shifting.

Soundtrack: “Scapes” by Artlist — licensed via Artlist.io.
